_comment: Waypoint graph for bot navigation. Each node connects to nearby nodes (≤38 tiles for PathFollower's A* to handle, with 32-tile soft limit for safety). Edges are made bidirectional automatically. After editing, run [ReloadWaypoints in-game. Coords were captured via [where in-game; Z values are critical — don't change them unless you re-verify the location.

Waypoints._note: Sewer entrance — likely teleports to Britain Sewers

Waypoints._note: Alley behind the inn near tailor

Waypoints.Name: Britain East Provisioner Alley
Waypoints._note: East alley near provisioner, Z=10 raised path

Waypoints.Name: Britain Inn East Road
Waypoints._note: East road south of inn, Z=10. Connections kept local to force routing through the relay chain in the inn corridor rather than long-distance shortcuts that fail A* pathfinding through narrow streets.

Waypoints._note: Stairs south of inn approach, Z=10

Waypoints._note: South end of the north corridor leading up past the forge to the graveyard. Entry from Virtue Path 3.
